units.source_text: （收音机和镜子……收音机和镜子……）——那样执着，仿佛人的全部生活，就只有这两样东西组成似的。

en.t: Radio and mirror... radio and mirror... She was so fixated on them, as if a person's entire life were made up of only those two things.

units.source_text: 原来如此，收音机也好，镜子也好，在连接他人这一点上，两者确实有相似的性质。

en.t: So that was it: both the radio and the mirror did indeed share a similar quality, in that they connected one with other people.

units.source_text: 或者可以说是关系到人存在的某种基础欲望。

en.t: Or perhaps one could say they were tied to some basic desire involved in human existence.

units.source_text: 不说了吧，到了那边，马上买一台收音机寄给她吧。

en.t: Enough of that. Once he got there, he would buy a radio at once and send it to her.

units.source_text: 倾其所有给她买一台最高级的半导体收音机。

en.t: He would spend everything he had to buy her the finest transistor radio available.
